name: handler_shiny
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via 'shiny' Widgets (GUI) in the HTML Browser

origin.description: Build a progression handler that updates a Shiny progress bar.
origin.usage: handler_shiny(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.gui", 1), target = "gui", inputs = list(message = NULL, detail = "message"), enable = getOption("progressr.enable", TRUE), ...)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Sources for the Shiny message and detail. The default detail source is "message".

arguments.name: enable
arguments.text: If FALSE, the handler is a no-op. The default follows progressr.enable, or TRUE when that option is unset.

origin.details: The handler is returned. A 2-step progressor with enable=TRUE reaches shiny::incProgress(), which stops because shiny is not installed.
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. Running it looks up a package that is not installed.

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would update a Shiny progress bar.
translation.usage: handler_shiny(intrusiveness=None, target="gui", inputs=None, enable=<progressr.enable or True>, **extra)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Sources for the Shiny message and detail. The default detail source is "message".

arguments.name: enable
arguments.text: If FALSE, the handler is a no-op. The default follows progressr.enable, or TRUE when that option is unset.

translation.details: The handler is returned. Running it with enable=True reaches the shiny lookup and stops. No Shiny session is opened.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. Running it looks up a package that is not installed.
translation.example:
from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.external import handler_shiny
from progressr.options import ProgressrError
from progressr.progressor import progressor

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
    progress()
    progress()

try:
    with_progress(body, handlers=handler_shiny(enable=True), enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
except ProgressrError as exc:
    print(f"handler_shiny() errors: {exc}.")
